description: Helper class for serialization of Java objects into JSON using Google's GSON, including methods for creating configured Gson instances and registering type adapters.

classes.name: GoogleGsonSerializerHelper
classes.description: A utility class providing methods to create and configure Gson instances with custom type adapters and exclusion strategies for JSON serialization.

methods.name: createGsonBuilderForPartialResponseFiltering
methods.description: Creates a Gson instance with an inclusion strategy based on provided response parameters.

methods.name: createGsonBuilderWithParameterExclusionSerializationStrategy
methods.description: Creates a Gson instance with an exclusion strategy based on supported and response parameters, throwing an exception if unsupported parameters are detected.

methods.name: serializedJsonFrom
methods.description: Serializes data objects into JSON string using the provided Gson serializer.

methods.name: createSimpleGson
methods.description: Creates a simple Gson instance with default configuration.

methods.name: createGsonBuilder
methods.description: Creates a GsonBuilder with registered type adapters.

methods.name: registerTypeAdapters
methods.description: Registers custom type adapters for various Java time classes and ExternalId.
